# Curated template cases. The expected result of each is recorded from the reference implementation
# (run `TemplateDiff golden`), so these pin behaviour rather than restate it.
#
# Format: "### name [missingkey=error] [noescape]", then optional "data: <json>" and "embed <name>: <json string>" lines,
# then "tmpl:" and the template text up to the next "###".

### text-only
data: {}
tmpl:
plain text, no actions

### field
data: {"a": "x", "n": 3, "f": 1.5, "b": true, "l": [1, "two", null], "m": {"k": "v", "j": 2}, "nul": null}
tmpl:
{{.a}} {{.n}} {{.f}} {{.b}} {{.l}} {{.m}} {{.nul}} {{.nope}} {{.m.k}} {{.m.zz}}

### nil-field-chain
data: {"nul": null}
tmpl:
{{.nul.x}}

### missing-chain
data: {}
tmpl:
[{{.a.b.c}}]

### missingkey-error
data: {"m": {}}
tmpl:
{{.m.zz}}

### missingkey-error-top [missingkey=error]
data: {}
tmpl:
{{.zz}}

### missingkey-error-present [missingkey=error]
data: {"a": null}
tmpl:
[{{.a}}]

### comments
data: {}
tmpl:
a{{/* comment */}}b{{- /* trim */ -}} c {{/* multi
line */}}d

### trim-markers
data: {"a": 1}
tmpl:
x   {{- .a -}}   y
  {{- if true }}  z  {{ end -}}
w

### number-minus-not-trim
data: {}
tmpl:
{{-3}} {{ -3 }} {{3 -}}

### constants
data: {}
tmpl:
{{1}} {{-2}} {{0x1F}} {{0b101}} {{0o17}} {{017}} {{1_000}} {{1.5}} {{1e3}} {{.5}} {{'a'}} {{'\n'}} {{"s\ttab\u00e9"}} {{`raw\n`}} {{true}} {{false}}

### string-escapes
data: {}
tmpl:
{{"a\"b\\c\x41\101\u00e9\U0001F600"}}

### bad-number
data: {}
tmpl:
{{1.2.3}}

### nil-command
data: {}
tmpl:
{{nil}}

### pipeline-basic
data: {"s": "Hello"}
tmpl:
{{.s | lower | printf "[%s]"}} {{printf "%s-%s" "a" "b"}} {{"x" | printf "%s-%s" "y"}}

### pipeline-nonexec
data: {}
tmpl:
{{1 | 2}}

### parens
data: {"l": [3, 4]}
tmpl:
{{(index .l 1)}} {{len (index .l 0 | printf "%d")}} {{(.l)}}

### chain-on-paren
data: {"m": {"a": {"b": "deep"}}}
tmpl:
{{(index .m "a").b}} {{(.m).a.b}}

### variables
data: {"a": 1}
tmpl:
{{$x := 5}}{{$x}} {{$x = 6}}{{$x}} {{$}} {{$.a}}

### variable-scope
data: {"a": 1}
tmpl:
{{$x := 1}}{{if true}}{{$x = 2}}{{$y := 3}}{{$x}}{{$y}}{{end}}{{$x}}

### variable-undefined
data: {}
tmpl:
{{$nope}}

### variable-assign-undeclared
data: {}
tmpl:
{{$z = 1}}

### if-else
data: {"a": 0, "b": "", "c": [], "d": {}, "e": "x", "f": 0.0, "g": null, "h": [0], "i": false}
tmpl:
{{if .a}}A{{else}}!A{{end}} {{if .b}}B{{else}}!B{{end}} {{if .c}}C{{else}}!C{{end}} {{if .d}}D{{else}}!D{{end}} {{if .e}}E{{end}} {{if .f}}F{{else}}!F{{end}} {{if .g}}G{{else}}!G{{end}} {{if .h}}H{{end}} {{if .i}}I{{else}}!I{{end}} {{if .nope}}N{{else}}!N{{end}}

### else-if-chain
data: {"n": 2}
tmpl:
{{if eq .n 1}}one{{else if eq .n 2}}two{{else if eq .n 3}}three{{else}}many{{end}}

### if-with-decl
data: {"n": 2}
tmpl:
{{if $v := .n}}{{$v}}{{else}}{{$v}}{{end}}

### range-list
data: {"l": ["a", "b", "c"]}
tmpl:
{{range .l}}[{{.}}]{{end}} {{range $i, $e := .l}}{{$i}}={{$e}};{{end}} {{range $e := .l}}{{$e}}{{end}}

### range-else
data: {"l": [], "m": {}}
tmpl:
{{range .l}}x{{else}}empty list{{end}} {{range .m}}x{{else}}empty map{{end}} {{range .nope}}x{{else}}missing{{end}}

### range-map-sorted
data: {"m": {"b": 2, "a": 1, "c": 3, "B": 0}}
tmpl:
{{range $k, $v := .m}}{{$k}}={{$v}} {{end}}|{{range .m}}{{.}} {{end}}

### range-int
data: {"n": 3}
tmpl:
{{range 3}}{{.}}{{end}} {{range $i := .n}}{{$i}}{{end}} {{range 0}}x{{else}}none{{end}} {{range -2}}x{{else}}neg{{end}}

### range-int-two-vars
data: {}
tmpl:
{{range $i, $e := 3}}{{end}}

### range-string
data: {"s": "ab"}
tmpl:
{{range .s}}{{.}}{{end}}

### range-break-continue
data: {"l": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]}
tmpl:
{{range .l}}{{if eq . 2}}{{continue}}{{end}}{{if eq . 4}}{{break}}{{end}}{{.}}{{end}}

### range-nested-break
data: {"l": [1, 2], "m": [10, 20]}
tmpl:
{{range .l}}{{range $.m}}{{if eq . 20}}{{break}}{{end}}{{.}}{{end}}/{{end}}

### break-outside
data: {}
tmpl:
{{break}}

### range-assign-vars
data: {"l": ["a", "b"]}
tmpl:
{{$i := -1}}{{$e := ""}}{{range $i, $e = .l}}{{end}}{{$i}}{{$e}}

### range-var-scope
data: {"l": [1]}
tmpl:
{{range $i, $e := .l}}{{end}}{{$i}}

### with
data: {"m": {"a": 1}, "e": "", "s": "x"}
tmpl:
{{with .m}}{{.a}}{{end}} {{with .e}}yes{{else}}no{{end}} {{with .s}}{{.}}{{end}} {{with $v := .s}}{{$v}}{{end}} {{with .nope}}x{{else with .s}}else-with {{.}}{{end}}

### define-template
data: {"name": "w"}
tmpl:
{{define "greet"}}Hello, {{.}}!{{end}}{{template "greet" .name}} {{template "greet" "x"}} {{template "greet"}}

### template-dollar
data: {"a": "root"}
tmpl:
{{define "t"}}[{{.}}|{{$}}]{{end}}{{template "t" "arg"}}

### template-undefined
data: {}
tmpl:
{{template "nope"}}

### template-recursion
data: {"n": 3}
tmpl:
{{define "f"}}{{if gt . 0}}{{.}}{{template "f" (printf "%d" (sub1 .))}}{{end}}{{end}}x

### template-recursive-list
data: {"t": {"v": "a", "kids": [{"v": "b", "kids": []}, {"v": "c", "kids": [{"v": "d", "kids": []}]}]}}
tmpl:
{{define "node"}}{{.v}}{{range .kids}}({{template "node" .}}){{end}}{{end}}{{template "node" .t}}

### block

tmpl:
{{block "b" .x}}default {{.}}{{end}} {{block "b" 2}}ignored{{end}}

### define-redefine

tmpl:
{{define "a"}}1{{end}}{{define "a"}}2{{end}}{{template "a"}}

{{define "a"}}1{{end}}{{define "a"}}{{end}}{{template "a"}}

### define-nested
data: {}

### define-only
data: {}
tmpl:
{{define "a"}}x{{end}}

### template-main-name
data: {}
tmpl:
{{define "x"}}{{template "template"}}{{end}}a

### and-or-not
data: {"z": 0, "o": 1, "s": "x", "e": ""}
tmpl:
{{and .o .s}} {{and .z .s}} {{or .z .e}} {{or .z .s}} {{not .z}} {{not .s}} {{and 1 2 3}} {{or 0 "" nil}} {{and}}

### and-or-short-circuit
data: {"m": {}}
tmpl:
{{and false (index .m "a" "b")}} {{or true (index .m "a" "b")}}

### and-or-args-one
data: {"x": 5}
tmpl:
{{and .x}} {{or .x}} {{.x | and 1}}

### comparison
data: {"a": 1, "b": 2, "s": "x", "t": "y", "f": 1.5, "g": 2.5, "t1": true, "n": null}
tmpl:
{{eq .a 1}} {{eq .a .b}} {{ne .a .b}} {{lt .a .b}} {{le .a .a}} {{gt .b .a}} {{ge .a .b}} {{eq .s "x"}} {{lt .s .t}} {{lt .f .g}} {{eq .t1 true}} {{eq .a 1 2 3}} {{eq .a 4 5 1}} {{eq .n nil}} {{eq .nope nil}} {{eq nil nil}}

### compare-mixed
data: {"a": 1, "f": 1.0}

{{eq .a .f}}

### print-functions

### printf-verbs
data: {"i": 42, "f": 3.14159, "s": "str", "b": true, "u": "é"}
tmpl:
{{printf "%d|%5d|%-5d|%05d|%+d|%x|%X|%o|%b|%c|%q|%U" .i .i .i .i .i .i .i .i .i .i .i .i}}
{{printf "%f|%.2f|%8.3f|%e|%g|%G|%v|%6.1f|%-8.2f|" .f .f .f .f .f .f .f .f .f}}
{{printf "%s|%10s|%-10s|%.2s|%q|%x|%v|%+v|%T" .s .s .s .s .s .s .s .s .s}}
{{printf "%t|%v|%5t|%q" .b .b .b .u}} {{printf "%T %T %T %T %T %T" .i .f .s .b nil .u}}
{{printf "%%|%5%|"}} {{printf "%d"}} {{printf "%d" 1 2}} {{printf "%z" 1}} {{printf "%"}} {{printf "%d %s" "x" 5}}

### printf-width-star
data: {}
tmpl:
{{printf "%*d|%-*d|%.*f" 5 42 4 7 2 3.14159}}

### printf-containers
data: {"l": [1, 2], "m": {"b": 1, "a": "x"}, "n": null, "ll": ["a", "b"]}
tmpl:
{{printf "%v %d %s %q %x" .l .l .ll .ll .l}} {{printf "%v %s" .m .m}} {{printf "%v|%d|%s" .n .n .n}}

### float-formatting
data: {"a": 1000000.0, "b": 100000.0, "c": 0.000001, "d": 0.0001, "e": 123456789.0, "f": 1e21, "g": 1e-7, "h": 1.5, "i": 100, "j": 2.0, "k": -0.5, "l": 1e100, "m": 0.1, "n": 3.0e10}
tmpl:

{{printf "%g|%.3g|%.10g|%e|%.0f|%.0e|%10.4g|%G" .a .a .a .a .a .a .a .a}}

### unclosed-paren
data: {}
tmpl:
{{ (1 }}

### unexpected-right-paren
data: {}
tmpl:
{{ 1) }}

### unexpected-end
data: {}
tmpl:
{{end}}

### unexpected-else
data: {}
tmpl:
{{else}}

### missing-end
data: {}
tmpl:
{{if true}}x

### unterminated-string
data: {}
tmpl:
{{"abc}}

### bad-char
data: {}
tmpl:
{{ @ }}

### empty-action
data: {}
tmpl:
{{}}

### empty-pipeline-parens
data: {}
tmpl:
{{()}}

### comment-spaced
data: {}
tmpl:
{{ /* x */ }}

### comment-unclosed
data: {}
tmpl:
{{/* never closed

### comment-garbage
data: {}
tmpl:
{{/* x */ y}}

### too-many-decls
data: {}
tmpl:
{{$a, $b := 1}}

### range-decl-comma
data: {"l": [1]}
tmpl:
{{range $a, 1 := .l}}{{end}}

### chained-number
data: {}
tmpl:
{{1.x}}

### field-on-string
data: {"s": "x"}
tmpl:
{{.s.len}}

### field-on-list
data: {"l": [1]}
tmpl:
{{.l.x}}

### dot-field-nested-ok
data: {"a": {"b": {"c": [1, {"d": "found"}]}}}
tmpl:
{{(index .a.b.c 1).d}} {{index .a.b.c 1 | printf "%v"}}

### keyword-as-field
data: {"if": 1, "range": 2, "end": 3}
tmpl:
{{.if}} {{.range}} {{.end}}

### unicode-fields
data: {"é": "accent", "日本": "cjk"}
tmpl:
{{.é}} {{.日本}}

### digits-in-field
data: {"a1": 1, "_x": 2}
tmpl:
{{.a1}} {{._x}}

### large-int
data: {"big": 9007199254740993, "huge": 12345678901234567890, "neg": -9223372036854775808}
tmpl:
{{.big}} {{.huge}} {{.neg}}

### int-overflow-literal
data: {}
tmpl:
{{9223372036854775808}}

### text-around-braces
data: {"a": 1}
tmpl:
{ {{.a}} } {{"}"}} {{.a}}}} x }}

### crlf-text
data: {"a": 1}
tmpl:
line1
  {{- .a }}
{{ .a -}}  
end

### map-in-range-values
data: {"m": {"x": {"n": 1}, "y": {"n": 2}}}
tmpl:
{{range $k, $v := .m}}{{$k}}:{{$v.n}} {{end}}

### nested-range-vars
data: {"a": [1, 2], "b": ["x", "y"]}
tmpl:
{{range $i, $x := .a}}{{range $j, $y := $.b}}{{$i}}{{$j}}{{$x}}{{$y}} {{end}}{{end}}

### with-else-chain
data: {"a": "", "b": 0, "c": "see"}
tmpl:
{{with .a}}A{{else with .b}}B{{else with .c}}C={{.}}{{else}}none{{end}}

### if-pipeline-fn
data: {"s": "abc"}
tmpl:
{{if hasPrefix .s "ab"}}yes{{end}} {{if not (contains .s "z")}}no-z{{end}} {{if and (hasPrefix .s "a") (hasSuffix .s "c")}}both{{end}}

### dollar-in-range
data: {"p": "P", "l": [1, 2]}
tmpl:
{{range .l}}{{$.p}}{{.}}{{end}}

### assign-in-range-persists
data: {"l": [1, 2, 3]}
tmpl:
{{$sum := 0}}{{range .l}}{{$sum = .}}{{end}}{{$sum}}

### variable-shadow
data: {}
tmpl:
{{$x := 1}}{{if true}}{{$x := 2}}{{$x}}{{end}}{{$x}}

### pipe-into-field-call
data: {"m": {"a": 1}}
tmpl:
{{1 | .m.a}}

### pipe-into-string
data: {}
tmpl:
{{"x" | "y"}}

### function-call-value-as-arg
data: {"l": [3, 1, 2]}
tmpl:
{{len (printf "%v" .l)}}

### index-of-call-result
data: {"s": "a,b,c"}
tmpl:
{{index (split "," .s) 1}}

### chained-pipes-many
data: {"s": " Mixed Case "}
tmpl:
{{.s | trim | lower | replace " " "_" | printf "%s!" | upper}}

### printf-bad-index-args
data: {}
tmpl:
{{printf "%s" .nope}} {{printf "%d" nil}} {{printf "%v" nil}} {{printf "%s %s" "a"}}

### nil-root-field
data: null
tmpl:
[{{.s}}]

### nil-root-dot
data: null
tmpl:
[{{.}}]

### nil-root-range
data: null
tmpl:
{{range $:=.s}}x{{end}}

### range-else-var
data: {"l": [1,2]}
tmpl:
{{range $e := 0}}{{else}}[{{$e}}]{{end}}

### range-else-var2
data: {"l": []}
tmpl:
{{range $i, $e := .l}}{{else}}[{{$i}}|{{$e}}]{{end}}

### range-else-dollar
data: {"l": []}
tmpl:
{{range $, $e := .l}}{{else}}[{{$}}]{{end}}

### range-dollar-body
data: {"l": [5,6]}
tmpl:
{{range $, $e := .l}}[{{$}}|{{$e}}]{{end}}

### range-elem-slice
data: {"l": [1,2,3], "i": [1]}
tmpl:
{{range $e := .i}}{{slice $.l $e}}{{end}}

### range-elem-index-dot
data: {"l": [1,2,3], "i": [1]}
tmpl:
{{range .i}}{{slice $.l .}}{{end}}

### range-elem-list
data: {"l": [1,2,3]}
tmpl:
{{range $e := (list 3)}}{{slice $.l $e}}{{end}}

### date-dot
data: {}
tmpl:
{{date "2006" "2020-12-31T23:59:59.+5:30"}}

### date-frac
data: {}
tmpl:
{{date "2006 05" "2020-12-31T23:59:59.5+05:30"}}

### range-noassign
data: {"l": [1]}
tmpl:
{{range $i, $e (len .l)}}x{{end}}

### range-noassign2
data: {"l": [1]}
tmpl:
{{range $i, $e}}x{{end}}

### printf-byte
data: {}
tmpl:
{{printf "%f" (index "lo" 1)}}

### fuzz-range-comma-root
data: {"l": [1, 2]}
tmpl:
{{range $,$}}x{{end}}|{{range $i,$ .l}}y{{end}}
### fuzz-range-comma-else
data: {"l": []}
tmpl:
{{range $,$e:=.l}}x{{else}}[{{$}}]{{end}}
### fuzz-printf-u-negative
data: {}
tmpl:
{{printf "%U" -1}} {{printf "%U" -2}} {{printf "%U" 65}}
### fuzz-printf-nested-nil-width
data: {"m": {"a": null}, "l": [null, 1]}
tmpl:
{{printf "%8f" .m}}|{{printf "%8f" .l}}|{{printf "%8v" .l}}
### fuzz-date-hour-and-offset
data: {}
tmpl:
{{date "15" "2024-03-05T4:07:09Z"}}
### fuzz-date-offset-one-digit

tmpl:
{{date "15" "1999-01-01T00:00:00-8:00"}}
### fuzz-date-offset-colon
data: {}
tmpl:
{{date "2006-01-02 15:04" "1999-01-01T10:30:00+05:30"}}
